notes.title: Attention! Cuteness Overload!
notes.content:
Hello Baristas! 

Full Release date is rapidly approaching and we are working hard to add lots of fun content to the game before the due date. One of the most requested feature from players was [b]more blobs[/b] and we heard you, loud and clear! 

Let us introduce you to our five new blobistas. 🤩
They are ready for you to befriend and to help you serve tons of coffee and save the planet from fatigue! 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/9cf9e91846cab4f9776c888f4aa1d84d80f0867f.png[/img]


These cuties are requested by our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tobugis]Twitch[/url] community during our live streams. Special thanks to our viewers for their immense support. 

If you would like to be a part of the game development process and get access to special perks, hop in to our streams. We will be happy to see you there! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/43731bf48cff0f38f41a03ceab8e8bb494db2a23.gif[/img]


❤️ Togis & Bu - Pyralis Studio ❤️

notes.title: Full Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3][h2] ☕ Save the date and ready your snacks ☕ [/h2][/h3]

Good day Baristas! 

We are very excited to share the news that our very first Steam game is releasing on Friday, March 14th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/60464c8b1bd8024de850ebda74bb6a16ece7a1a5.gif[/img]


[h1][h2]What to expect from the Full Release? [/h2][/h1]

[list]
[*] 8+ Hours of playtime
[*] 10+ Different Maps
[*] 5+ Different Enemies
[*] 10+ Cute Blobs to befriend
[*] 6 Different Buildings
[*] 70+ Unlockable Upgrades
[*] 5 Power Ups
[*] 40+ Achivements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/43731bf48cff0f38f41a03ceab8e8bb494db2a23.gif[/img]

This feels like a dream. We both have been working on Wake Cup about a year, every single moment we could find from our main jobs and responsibilities. We can not believe the time is almost here! 

We learned a lot on the process and a lot from your feedbacks, thank you for joining this amazing journey and your immense support! ❤️

Togis & Bu - Pyralis Studio 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/7a5c221fb85d82e0a612f3b9822b9efc274a73ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Wake Cup Demo is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/ac23f619d57e7960977bd35d71880217ce17ee07.png[/img][h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that the demo of Wake Cup is now live on Steam! 🎉


[h2]Available in the Demo:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Experience the first few levels and get a taste of the chaotic chill gameplay.
[*] Discover the unique harmony of casual tower defence and clicker games. 
[*] Develop different strategies and adapt as your business grows and evolves as you play more and upgrade your shop with a meta progression. 
[/list]

We are eager to hear your feedback, so please share your thoughts and experiences with us. Your feedback is crucial to help us improve the game before the full release. 

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the demo!

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/tobugisvid]Twitter[/url] and join our Discord server or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tobugis]Twitch livestreams[/url] for the latest updates and community discussions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/dc1d6364a255dd8ac7d2dd9f38bc27f9631a58df.png[/img]


Happy Clicking! ☕☕☕

Togis and Bu from Pyralis Studio ❤️

notes.title: Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/db5bc1c296ad195938f7dda5040cecd3bc7f29d6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924869/f519443825b73f3551269d7a8c82c4da92c69c26.png[/img][/url]

[b]Hello Coffee Lovers! [/b]

Here we are with our very first Steam game and we already left the first week behind! 
It is very exciting times. As much as it is exciting, it is the most intense problem solving period of a game launch! 

We have been working hard to make sure that you have an amazing time with our little game. Here are the updates of the 1st week into Early Access. 

[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements 
[*] Performance improvements 
[*] Production chain balances - Coffee beans and coffee consummation ratio 
[*] General balance of towers - Bombard and Hotspot 
[*] Tons of bugs squished (sorry little buddies) 
[*] Working on Linux Steam Achievements
[/list]

If you encounter any problems and crashes, you can report them on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/WkTN2NAbxc

Thank you for your patience and support! Happy clicking!
